sam: onboarding tangelo-12b (int4) to canary. quick smoke shows p95 spike + OOM on long prompts.
mina: paste logs?
yoel: snippet from canary host:
```
2024-03-02T11:02:10Z OOM during KV resize (need 16MB)
slab_free=920 frag=49% compactions=0
trace: batch=5 max_new_tokens=220 avg_seq=640
```
tara: frag ~50% with batch=5 is dangerous on int4. suggestions: reduce max_new_tokens default, cap batch_size for long-route, enable aggressive slot compactor.
sam: tried max_new_tokens=80 locally -> mem stable but summarization quality drops.
ciara: queue eval: longform-QA and summarization comparison int4 vs fp16, quality gate BLEU/ROUGE tolerances set. link when ready.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: tangelo-12b-int4-canary -> canary-2 (id d-4012).
yoel: also try batching.window_ms=25 and batch_max_tokens=120 to avoid >3 concurrent KV writers. soft-evict prefix cache at 0.6.
mina: will patch canary with those params, watch CPU (compactor=aggressive ups CPU). report back in 25m.
sam: if eval fails -> immediate fallback to fp16 for /longread routes and open ticket for allocator improvements. :thumbsup:
